bounds_and_publication: New bounded post-terminal component only; no changes to any original native gate budget or source. The final budget is not fixed until actual H4 inventory and parent verification cost are reviewed.
Retain the existing hard explicit inventory cap of at most32 complete files and4GiB logical actual source bytes; allow exactly one non-recursive complete parent archive.

For child physical payload bytes, bound compressed output by actual new embedded ELF bytes plus64MiB metadata allowance; continue4MiB or smaller parts and full part/whole SHA coverage. A metadata-only child is permitted only when the entire required parent closure is present and verified.

Before final publication, verify all child embedded members, reconstruct and hash every child logical complete-image view through either embedded bytes or the exact complete parent member, and recheck selected H4 source identities.

Keep xz preset3 single process and the same regular-only, two source reads, no-overwrite publication, archive/part/member verification and data+directory fsync order as the already reviewed exporters.

Publication marker must say COMPLETE_WITH_REFERENCED_PARENT rather than imply the child archive is standalone. Require a successful authoritative archive job and explicit closure manifest; failure leaves only owned staging artifacts and no successful completion.

child_index_design.complete_images: one row per unique H4 complete image; every row retains H4 selected path, all aliases, original observations and two actual source read receipts
explicit_totals: total actual H4 logical complete-image bytes
unique new physical ELF bytes embedded in the child archive
count of H4 source files actually read twice
all original alias count and count not reopened
partial artifact count and independent representation scope
child_index_design.inventory_bytes_and_sha256: mandatory exact raw H4 inventory embedded without rewriting observations
child_index_design.native_job_outcome: exact H4 terminal, never replaced by archive outcome
child_index_design.partial_artifacts: Do not auto-generalize H2 prefix logic. If the actual H4 inventory contains partials, retain them as partial evidence and obtain a separate reviewed lossless representation. No partial can satisfy a complete reference or process binding.

reused_payload_row.bytes: actual H4 full length, equal to parent member length
reused_payload_row.h4_actual_reads: first and independent second complete source read receipts
reused_payload_row.h4_native_observations: this run's raw FD/live/process observations only
reused_payload_row.parent_member: literal complete member from the validated H3 index
reused_payload_row.sha256: actual H4 full SHA256, equal to parent member full SHA

current_bulk_state: H1/H2/H3 remain PAUSED with no new remote reads. H4 owns the desktop native window.
decision_prerequisites: H4 authoritative terminal and exact owned-unit/cgroup/descendant release.
Model agent freezes H4 inventory only from this run's actual FD/live/process capture records, including unmatched records and partial artifacts.
Root reviews whether complete H4 image hashes actually overlap the verified H3 parent inventory enough to justify the added dependency.
Root fixes source/inventory/plan/tool hashes, budget and an independent archive window before any remote execution.
final_consumer_requirements: Receive and verify the entire original H3 archive and all its original part hashes/offsets, then decompress and hash its16 actual members and pinned index. Existing remote success or a downloaded index alone is insufficient.
Receive and verify the entire H4 child archive, its parts, embedded exact H4 inventory and actual read/capture receipts, child index and fixed parent dependency reference.

Check parent archive/index/member SHA and size at every reference. Reject unknown parents, transitive references, cycles, duplicate/ambiguous names, missing members, nonregular members, path traversal and partial-as-complete representations.

Reconstruct each logical H4 complete image by its representation and hash every byte; verify those full hashes and lengths against both this run's actual source reads and its original retained-image capture identity.
Independently validate H4 FD/case/PID/start-time attribution and original native outcome; matching ELF bytes never repairs an H4 missing process observation or imports H3 PASS credit.

Mark the complete H4 byte closure durable only after all referenced parent and child artifacts are available and verified at the final storage destination. A child metadata package alone is not binary persistence.

parent_archive.logical_role: Content-addressed byte source only; no H3 test/FD/owner/learning qualification credit transfers to H4.

parent_binding_at_export: Validate the exact successful H3 completion, plan/exporter hashes and previously rehashed actual index without accepting a same-named replacement.

Reopen and fully hash the pinned actual parent archive during the new component, and verify every referenced complete member against the pinned parent index before publishing a successful reference-based child. This is storage verification after native terminal, not new test execution.

Record the parent file identity used and recheck it before publication. If the parent disappears, changes or lacks any referenced member, reject completion; retaining a dangling metadata reference is not successful delivery.
proposed_actual_source_protocol: Accept only exact H4 retained source paths enumerated by the new frozen inventory; never target glob, rebuild, infer missing captures, or substitute another alias after a selected path failure.

Preserve H4 original source commit/tree/lock/environment/config pins, actual native outcomes, every FD/live case/PID/start-tick observation, and all original retained aliases without importing H3 observation records.

For every selected H4 complete image, walk canonical paths without symlinks and read a regular single-link file with exact planned size. Actually hash every byte and verify ELF magic; record complete inode/device/size/mtime/ctime/mode identity.

Require the actual read SHA and byte count to equal that H4 image's own recorded retained-image identity before considering content reuse. Equal source commit, binary pathname, package or prior hash metadata alone never qualifies.
Perform a second independent full read of every selected H4 complete image, including referenced images, with the same identity and hash. Record that all unselected aliases remain metadata only.

Match only a complete parent H3 image row with the exact same full SHA256 and size. References may target only the literal H3/elf/<SHA>.elf member in the one pinned parent archive/index. No partial prefix or transitive reference can qualify as a complete image.

If an actual H4 SHA/size has no exact complete parent row, export the actual H4 retained bytes in the new child archive using the reviewed two-read, no-overwrite, member verification, part verification and fsync protocol. A missing selected source or parent-identity mismatch fails closed rather than silently invoking fallback/rebuild.
Never change original H4 runtime results because archival data match a parent. Preserve any absent capture or unmatched child/helper attribution as absent/unmatched.
